answer: Feature engineering is used for selecting the most useful features among existing ones, combining existing features to produce more useful ones, and creating new features by gathering new data [uow_ai_ml_p019_paragraph_001]. It is also used to extract meaningful features from raw data for machine learning, such as brain region volumes from imaging [colliot_ml_2023_p020_paragraph_004].
